Name: earthCARE_orbit_track
Title: EarthCARE Orbit Track
Description: Ground track of the EarthCARE satellite for a single orbit. EarthCARE (Earth Cloud, Aerosol and Radiation Explorer) is a joint ESA/JAXA mission launched on 28 May 2024. The satellite flies in a sun-synchronous orbit at 393 km altitude with an inclination of 97.1° and an orbital period of 92.5 minutes. Its near-polar orbit crosses the equator in the early afternoon, providing optimal illumination and minimal sun glint for the passive instruments. The ground track repeats every 25 days.
